sn56.17:1.1: Sitting to one side, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn56.17:1.4: and in what way is one immersed in ignorance?”
sn56.17:1.5: “Bhikkhu, not knowing suffering, not knowing the origin of suffering, not knowing the cessation of suffering, not knowing the way leading to the cessation of suffering:
sn56.17:1.7: and it is in this way that one is immersed in ignorance.
sn56.17:2.1: “Therefore, bhikkhu, an exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is suffering.’… An exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of suffering.’”
